design.quote: In a two-arm, parallel-group, multi-centre randomised, non-inferiority clinical trial

population.quote: adults at risk of type 2 diabetes (i.e. with overweight or obesity and a score of ≥15 on the Australian type 2 diabetes risk assessment tool)
population.value: adults at risk of type 2 diabetes (i.e. with overweight or obesity and a score of ≥15 on the Australian type 2 diabetes risk assessment tool)

sample_size.quote: One hundred and twenty four participants were randomised to TRE and 123 to IDG

intervention.quote: TRE (9 h, self-selected eating window, last eating occasion by 19:00 hours)
intervention.value: TRE (9 h, self-selected eating window, last eating occasion by 19:00 hours)

follow_up.quote: Adverse events were tracked for 12 months.

primary_findings.quote: At 4 months, TRE was non-inferior but not superior to IDG for HbA1c (mean [95% CI]: -0.22 [-0.72, 0.30] mmol/mol; -0.02 [-0.07, 0.03]%; p=0.40).
